label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows into host variable, which is used in URI creation at line 48. While InetAddress.getAllByName(host) performs DNS resolution and loops check for non-public addresses, this only validates resolved IPs—not the original hostname. An attacker can supply a domain name that resolves to a public IP (bypassing the non-public check), enabling SSRF to internal services. The resolved sink value at line 48 is http://<user-hostname> where <user-hostname> remains attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: User param flows to host, DNS resolution occurs, but final fetch uses unvalidated host in URI
